findings.source_locator: decidability.tex lines 23-42; atomic-type quotient and truth-preservation exercise
findings.source_issue: Ordering worlds by inclusion of atomic truth sets creates new accessible pairs and need not preserve implication; the claimed induction for every formula over P is false.
findings.minimal_treatment: Use truth types over the finite subformula set S of the target formula, keep subset accessibility, restrict the induction and exercise to S, and disclose the repair.
